lead: Built-in parts of a home – fitted kitchens, bathrooms and wellness rooms, fireplaces, doors, stairs and floors, heating, water, power and control systems, and fixed outdoor structures – grouped into six zones of the house.

depts.note: Fitted and built-in kitchen equipment; freestanding appliances and cookware stay in Kitchen & Dining (B5).

b.w: Carcass material, hinges and drawer runners decide how a fitted kitchen ages.
Oven accuracy, burner output and steam functions separate everyday from enthusiast cooking.

s.brief: Variety at the top end: fitted-kitchen makers as archetypes/systems (Bulthaup b1/b3/b Solitaire, Boffi, Poggenpohl, SieMatic, Bespoke English makers such as deVOL and Plain English), cabinet styles (Shaker, handleless) as types. Worktops by material as types (quartz, granite, marble, solid surface, stainless, wood). Kitchen tap: boiling-water taps (Quooker), pull-out and pro taps. Waste disposal: trim SKUs to InSinkErator and market leaders.

k.brief: Whole kitchen of cabinets and island as one installed system; archetypes Bulthaup b3, Boffi, SieMatic, deVOL Shaker.
Installed kitchen work surface; materials as types.
Sink taps incl. boiling-water and filter taps (Quooker, Dornbracht, Grohe); bath/basin taps live in Bath & wellness.

s.brief: Mixed: tier for mainstream built-in ovens/hobs (Miele, Neff, Bosch, Siemens + Which?/CR winners); variety at enthusiast end with archetypes: La Cornue Château, Lacanche (Sully, Cluny), Officine Gullo, Wolf dual-fuel range, AGA (heat-storage original, eR7/eR3), Rayburn, Esse; Gaggenau 400/200 series, Vario hobs; Sub-Zero integrated columns, Gaggenau Vario cooling. Built-in only: freestanding fridges and dishwashers stay in B5.

k.brief: Wide freestanding-look cooker with several ovens and a hob; La Cornue, Lacanche, Wolf, Officine Gullo, Falcon.
Cast-iron always-on cooker: AGA, Rayburn, Esse, Everhot.
Single/double/compact wall ovens; Gaggenau 400 series.
Built-in steam, combi-steam and microwave-combi ovens.
Gas, induction, ceramic as types; Gaggenau Vario, Bora venting hob, Wolf.
Chimney, island, ceiling and downdraft extraction; Gaggenau, Bora, Westin, Falmec.
Integrated and built-in fridge/freezer columns; Sub-Zero, Gaggenau Vario, Liebherr, Miele MasterCool.
Integrated wine storage; Sub-Zero, Gaggenau, Liebherr, EuroCave built-in.
Plumbed or built-in bean-to-cup units; Miele, Gaggenau, Siemens.

depts.note: Bathroom fittings, saunas, steam rooms and hot tubs.

b.v: plated plastic · brass body · solid brass/forged with ceramic cartridges
b.w: Body material and cartridge decide leaks and lifespan.

b.v: acrylic · steel enamel · vitreous china · cast iron/stone resin
b.w: Material sets warmth, weight, chip resistance and price.

s.brief: Variety at design end: Dornbracht (Tara, MEM), Lefroy Brooks (1900 Classic), Vola (KV1 by Arne Jacobsen), Axor/Hansgrohe, Grohe; Toto Neorest and Washlet as archetypes, Geberit AquaClean; roll-top cast-iron baths (Drummonds, Catchpole & Rye), Victoria + Albert, Kaldewei steel baths; period styles (Victorian, Art Deco) as types. Cut the TOTO SKU list to archetypes and versions. Bath panel merges into Bathtub as a type/accessory.

k.brief: Freestanding, roll-top, built-in; bath panels as a type.
Toto Neorest (integrated) and Washlet (seat) archetypes; Geberit AquaClean; trim SKU list.
Dornbracht, Lefroy Brooks, Vola KV1, Axor; outside taps as a type.
Mixer, electric, power and digital showers as types; rain heads; Dornbracht, Axor, Mira, Aqualisa.

s.brief: Mostly restraint; merge bath/shower screen into enclosure (types: quadrant, walk-in, bath screen). Heated towel rails get design archetypes (Zehnder, Bisque, Vola, Vogue). Bathroom clothes dryer stays as a restraint kind.

Variety: sauna traditions (Finnish sauna, smoke sauna, Russian banya, Turkish hammam) in the traditions register; makers Klafs (S1), Harvia, Tylö, Huum, Saunum; heaters as their own kind (Harvia Legend/Cilindro, Huum Drop/Hive); steam rooms/showers (Klafs, Tylö, Steamist); hot tubs tier (Jacuzzi, Caldera, Hot Spring, Lay-Z-Spa winners) – cut Caldera SKU list; wood-fired tubs (Nordic/Japanese ofuro) and cold plunge tubs.

k.brief: Indoor and outdoor/barrel saunas; Klafs, Harvia, Tylö.
Wood-fired, electric and infrared emitters; Harvia, Huum, Tylö, Kastor.
Folding infrared and tent saunas as types.
Steam cabin or steam shower with generator; Klafs, Tylö, Steamist.

depts.note: Fixed heat and comfort features of living rooms; portable heaters and fans are in Portable Climate & Air (B7).

b.w: Ecodesign and EPA tests rate efficiency and particulates.

s.brief: Variety at design end: Stûv (16, 21, 30), Morsø, Jøtul, Contura, Scan, Rais, Focus (Gyrofocus), Charnwood, Hwam; tiled stoves/masonry heaters (Kachelofen, Swedish kakelugn, Russian stove) as traditions; pellet stoves; fireplace surrounds and mantels with period styles as types (Georgian, Victorian, Art Deco).

k.brief: Wood and multi-fuel stoves; Stûv, Morsø, Jøtul.
Flued inset fires and fireplace inserts, any fuel; Gyrofocus archetype.
Tiled stove / kachelofen / kakelugn.
Bioethanol, flueless gas and built-in electric fires as types.

s.brief: Ceiling fans: archetypes (Big Ass Fans Haiku, Fanimation, Minka-Aire, Hunter, Casablanca), trim SKUs. Installed architectural audio and AV fittings only; freestanding audio/TV stays in Audio & Video (D3), cross-link.

k.brief: Architectural speakers fitted in walls/ceilings; Sonance, KEF Ci, Bowers & Wilkins CCM, Origin Acoustics.

k.n: Motorised TV lift and projection screen
k.brief: Built-in lifts, ceiling-recessed screens; Future Automation, Screen Excellence.

depts.note: Doors, windows, stairs, lifts and floors as fitted parts of the house; raw boards and timber are in Building Materials (C8).

b.w: Window and door energy ratings (BFRC, NFRC) set heat loss.

b.v: none · PAS 24 · Secured by Design / TS007 3-star
b.w: UK police-backed standards for doors, windows and locks.

s.brief: Tier: market brands plus test winners (Velux roof windows as archetype; Hörmann garage doors; Andersen, Marvin, Crittall steel windows; Origin bifolds). Door frame merges into Door; multipoint gearbox becomes the lock's spare-parts entry. Window/door styles (sash, casement, bi-fold, French) as types.

k.brief: Entrance, internal, patio and bi-fold doors as types; frames/linings included.
Sash, casement, tilt-and-turn, steel (Crittall) as types.
Gearbox as the single spare-parts entry.

s.brief: Staircases: straight, spiral, floating/cantilever as types; Stiltz and Savaria home lifts; stairlifts tier (Stannah, Acorn, Handicare + Which? winners).

k.brief: Through-floor and platform lifts for houses.

s.brief: Restraint: construction and finish as types (solid/engineered, parquet patterns; LVT, sheet). Keep few market brands.

depts.note: Heating, cooling, water, power and control systems; tier for plant, variety for luxury automation.

b.w: EU/UK ErP labels and US DOE ratings for boilers, heat pumps and water heaters.
How far a system joins a home-control platform (Matter, Crestron, Control4).

s.brief: Variety at luxury end: Crestron (Home OS), Control4, Savant, Lutron (HomeWorks, RadioRA 3, Caséta, Palladiom keypads), KNX as an open standard; motorised shading (Lutron Sivoia, Somfy); thermostats tier (Nest Learning Thermostat, Ecobee, tado, Hive, Honeywell T-series); intruder alarms and video door entry (2N, Ring, Yale) with cross-link to Home Safety & Security (B8).

k.brief: Whole-home control platforms: Crestron, Control4, Savant, Loxone, KNX.
Lutron HomeWorks/RadioRA/Caséta, Philips Dynalite; dimmers and keypads.
Lutron Sivoia/Palladiom shades, Somfy motors.

s.brief: Variety at design end: switch ranges as archetypes (Forbes & Lomax, Jung LS 990, Gira, Corston, Hamilton, Lutron dimmers, Bticino); plug types A–O as types of socket; consumer units and breakers restraint.

Tier for boilers/furnaces (Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Viessmann, Ideal; Carrier, Lennox, Trane + Which?/CR winners). Variety for designer and period radiators: Zehnder Charleston column, Bisque, cast-iron Victorian (Carron), Vola, Runtal.

k.brief: Steel and cast-iron column radiators; period styles as types.

s.brief: Restraint: merge wall, floor and cassette indoor units into one split AC kind with types; tier brands (Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Fujitsu, LG, Samsung, Vaillant aroTHERM, Kensa) plus test winners.
Restraint: one kind per water-heater principle; solar collectors merge into Solar water heater as a type.

Restraint: dissolve 'Other plumbed water filters' into whole-house and under-sink filters (shower filters are in Bath & wellness); cartridges and softener salt become one spare-parts/consumables entry.
Restraint: MVHR/PIV as types of ventilation unit; trim SKU lists.

Restraint: all inverter kinds collapse into one Inverter (string, hybrid, micro, off-grid as types); charge controllers, battery chargers, enclosures and mounts become one Solar system parts entry. Off-grid kits cross-link Vehicles (G1) for van/boat use.

depts.note: Fixed outdoor structures; movable garden furniture and barbecues are in Garden & Grounds (C2).

b.v: overlap/shiplap · tongue-and-groove · log 28–70 mm · insulated SIP
b.w: Cladding and wall thickness set durability and year-round use.

s.brief: Built-in outdoor kitchens (Wolf/Sub-Zero outdoor, Gaggenau, Kalamazoo, Lynx); bioclimatic pergolas (Renson); pools: construction types (concrete, liner, fibreglass) and natural swimming pools as types; trim pool-builder SKU noise.

k.brief: Built-in outdoor kitchen, roofed or open; garden kitchen building included.

s.brief: Restraint: trim long builder/SKU lists (shed, log cabin, summerhouse, office) to market-covering makers; wall construction as types.
